faqs.q: What quality photo do I need to upload?
faqs.a: A clear, well-lit phone or camera photo of your product is enough — we standardize lighting, background, and framing from there. We'll flag anything too low-resolution to work with before you're charged.
Every catalog image includes one round of revisions as part of the price. Additional revisions can be requested at a small added cost.

faqs.q: Can this replace my product photography entirely?
faqs.a: For most ecommerce catalog needs, yes — Classic Catalog covers standard product shots at scale. If your brand has a very specific art direction, Custom Brand Catalog is built for that instead.
